errors.error: ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree: react-native-dynamic peer react@18 conflicts with react@19
Could not start Gradle daemon — insufficient memory or stale daemon
errors.solution: Disable daemon and increase heap: org.gradle.daemon=false, org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m

errors.pattern: Failed to find Build Tools|Android SDK not found|compileSdk
errors.error: Android SDK / Build Tools not found for required compileSdk
errors.solution: Use a prebuilt environment image that already contains the SDK (GHCR builder).

errors.error: Manifest merger failed: uses-sdk minSdk > dependency maxSdk or conflicting permissions
errors.solution: Align minSdkVersion across modules or add tools:replace in AndroidManifest.

errors.error: Production signing keystore is not configured.
errors.solution: Configure EAS credentials or provide a keystore via secrets. Build a debug APK in the meantime.
